subject: Formal complaint, we are taking legal advice on this transaction
body: This is the fourth time I am raising this and I am done being passed around. A transaction on our account for a significant sum has been disputed for over three weeks and nobody has given me a straight answer. Our legal counsel has now been engaged and we will be pursuing this formally if it is not resolved this week. I am not interested in another documentation link or a suggestion to check an error code. I want a phone call with our account manager today, and I want it in writing who is accountable for this. Reference on our side is CASE-20988. Do not close this ticket.
